text:
I read all nine tracked files. The basics are in place, but there's no structured data and the content is very thin. I haven't run the site, so this is from reading the source only.

## What's already right
- Every indexable page has a title, description, canonical URL and a single `<h1>`. `<html lang="en">` is set at `app/layout.tsx:5`.
- Pages are server-rendered, so crawlers see the content without running JavaScript.
- `/account` is `noindex` (`app/account/page.tsx:1`), left out of the sitemap and disallowed in robots.txt.
- The sitemap is valid and lists all three public pages. `robots.txt` points to it at line 11.
- The robots.txt blocks match the policy in `geo.config.json:6-9`. `GPTBot` and `ClaudeBot` are training crawlers, so blocking them is intended. The search and user-fetch bots (`OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `Claude-User`, `PerplexityBot`) fall under `User-agent: *` / `Allow: /`, so AI search can still cite you.
- `data-nosnippet` at `app/layout.tsx:9` only covers the cookie notice, which is fine.

## Problems, most important first

1. **The content is too thin to be cited or ranked** (`app/page.tsx:4`, `app/varieties/page.tsx:4`, `app/visit/page.tsx:4`). Each page is one sentence. AI answer engines need extractable facts, and a single sentence gives them almost nothing.
   - **Fix:** Expand each page.
   - **Home:** what you sell, how to buy, and shipping.
   - **Varieties:** give each variety its own page, e.g. `/varieties/[slug]`, with flavour, use, pollination group and season. Add those pages to the sitemap.
   - **Visit:** add the content listed in item 3.

2. **No structured data anywhere.** There is no JSON-LD in any file.
   - **Fix:**
     - In `app/layout.tsx`, add `Organization` or `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD with name, URL, logo, address and founding date (1952).
     - Add `Product` markup to the variety pages.
     - On `app/visit/page.tsx`, add `openingHoursSpecification` and `geo` to the `LocalBusiness` markup.

3. **The Visit description promises content the page doesn't have** (`app/visit/page.tsx:1` vs `:4`). The description says "Opening times and directions", but the body only says "Open Thursday to Sunday, April to October". There's no address, no hours of the day, no directions and no parking or contact details.
   - **Fix:** Add them to the page, and mirror them in the JSON-LD from item 2.

4. **There are no site-wide metadata defaults** (`app/layout.tsx:1`). It sets only `metadataBase`. There's no `openGraph` (title, description, image, `siteName`), no `twitter` card, and no default title template. Link previews will be bare, and any new page that forgets its own metadata will have no title at all.
   - **Fix:** Add `title: { default, template: '%s | Orchard' }`, plus `openGraph`, `twitter` and a default image.

5. **Training-crawler blocks are incomplete** (`public/robots.txt:5-9`). The policy is "block training", but only `GPTBot` and `ClaudeBot` are blocked.
   - **Fix:** Add `anthropic-ai`, `Google-Extended`, `Applebot-Extended`, `CCBot` and `Bytespider` (plus any others you want covered), each with `Disallow: /`.
   - **Fix:** Optionally add explicit `Allow: /` groups for `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `Claude-User` and `PerplexityBot`. They're allowed today only through the wildcard, so a later edit to `*` could silently block them.

6. **The sitemap has no `<lastmod>`** (`public/sitemap.xml:3-5`). Without it, crawlers and AI indexers can't tell what changed.
   - **Fix:** Replace the static file with `app/sitemap.ts` so it's generated from the variety data and carries real dates.

7. **The site name is generic and unconnected** (`app/page.tsx:1`). "Orchard" alone is hard to resolve as an entity.
   - **Fix:** Use a distinctive brand name in titles and in `Organization` JSON-LD. Add `sameAs` links to social or business profiles if you have them.

## Low priority
- `app/account/page.tsx:1` combined with `robots.txt:3`: the Disallow stops crawlers from reading the `noindex`. That's harmless while nothing links to `/account`. If you ever link it, remove the Disallow and rely on `noindex`.
- `app/layout.tsx:7` uses plain `<a>` tags. Use `next/link` for client-side navigation. This isn't an SEO issue.
- An `llms.txt` is optional. No major AI search engine is documented as using it, so don't expect results from it.
- The canonical URLs in the pages are absolute. With `metadataBase` set, you can make them relative (`'/'`, `'/varieties'`) to avoid the origin being repeated in several places.

I haven't changed any files. I can implement items 2 to 6 if you'd like. The copy for items 1 and 3 needs your real details (address, hours, variety information).
